registry_policy.ordered_ids: Require exact ordered case IDs, per-ID mappings, and counts; reject missing/duplicate/reordered IDs.
registry_policy.edits: Apply every literal edit exactly once to one disposable producer copy; never edit the independent consumer.
registry_policy.producer_stage: Successful producer compilation is mandatory before attempting the client. A producer failure does not establish a client dependency.
registry_policy.client_stage: Compile the unchanged independent consumer against the mutated producer artifact and the same transitive source closure, rebuilding every affected descendant before the consumer.
registry_policy.diagnostics: The class/check names below identify intended surfaces, not a substring acceptance rule. Before final replay, record and freeze every complete stdout/stderr diagnostic for each case with strict bytes/UTF-8 policy. Reject extra or unrelated diagnostics on either stream.
registry_policy.outcomes: Expected outcomes are prospective, not observations. Assign observed verdicts only after actual producer and client execution. No case presently closes an acceptance row.
registry_policy.cleanup: Independently verify live-source and tool identities and disposable cleanup in finally, even after setup/compiler/client failure.
